parent.title: A weekend in Ouches anchored on Troisgros

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Troisgros
siblings.summary: Ranked day-trip menu within 30 km of Troisgros — anchor villages, heritage, wine, and outdoor stops, with a recommended Saturday-afternoon + Sunday-morning circuit around the dinner anchor.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Troisgros
siblings.summary: Six distinctive places to sleep within a short taxi ride of Maison Troisgros in Ouches — from the on-site Bois Dormant to Finnish kotas with private jacuzzis.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Troisgros
siblings.summary: Within 30 km of Troisgros the IT scene is thin — Roanne is the only hub. The Fête de la Science Village des Sciences (Oct 2-12, 2026) is the only public tech event that aligns with a weekend dinner; everything else is weekday or has already happened.

sources.title: Gault & Millau — Hotel Troisgros
sources.claim: Le Bois Dormant has 15 rooms (12 in Grande Maison + 3 in Maison des Kakis), Relais & Châteaux 5-star, rooms from €300 without breakfast.

sources.title: Le Pré Cheval — Les hébergements
sources.claim: Le Pré Cheval offers three gîtes priced €220–320/night with a €25/pp Troisgros breakfast basket on reservation.

sources.title: Gîtes de France Loire — Domaine Bérenguer (42G3714)
sources.claim: Domaine Bérenguer has 3 rooms at €130/night (breakfast included), 1 km from Troisgros, Gîtes de France certified since 2021.

sources.title: Domaine d'Aromm — chambres d'hôtes & écurie
sources.claim: Domaine d'Aromm has 5 rooms €125–165/night with breakfast included, ~10–15 min walk to Troisgros, on 27 ha with pool and ponds.

sources.title: Château d'Origny — Bed & Breakfast
sources.claim: Château d'Origny is a 5-suite B&B in Ouches offering free return transportation to La Maison Troisgros restaurant.

sources.title: Le Bois Dormant — Troisgros
sources.claim: Le Bois Dormant is closed Dec 22 2025 – Jan 14 2026; breakfast costs €40 per person; check-in 4 pm, check-out 11 am; sits on a 17-hectare estate at 728 Route de Villerest, Ouches.

sources.title: Ticati — Maison Troisgros
sources.claim: Average official price for a double room at Maison Troisgros (with breakfast) is €510.

sources.title: TripAdvisor — Troisgros Hotel review
sources.claim: Maison Troisgros hotel is rated 4.6/5 across 375 TripAdvisor reviews, holds Travellers' Choice, with guests reporting no local taxis and limited Uber service.

sources.title: Le Pré Cheval — Troisgros
sources.claim: Le Pré Cheval is Marion Troisgros's farm a few minutes' walk from Domaine de Ouches and operates as a separate establishment from Maison Troisgros.

sources.title: Loire Tourisme — Le Pré Cheval (Ouches)
sources.claim: Le Pré Cheval has 5 bedrooms with total capacity of 17 people, at 1005 route de Villerest, 42155 Ouches; closed Mondays and Tuesdays.

sources.title: Château d'Origny — Presentation
sources.claim: Château d'Origny is a 16th-century property near Roanne with two helicopter pads, suite rooms and a gourmet restaurant; chef Julien Laval holds a Michelin star since 2023.

sources.title: TripAdvisor — Château d'Origny B&B review
sources.claim: Château d'Origny B&B is ranked #1 of 2 B&Bs in Ouches at 4/5 across 131 reviews; observed rate around $187/night.

sources.title: Roannais Tourisme — Domaine d'Aromm
sources.claim: Domaine d'Aromm is an equestrian chambre d'hôtes in Ouches with a heated pool, two ponds and walking access to Troisgros through Roannaise countryside.
